title: Week of September 28, 2026
summary: Lewes gets a maritime weekend: Boast the Coast fills the canalfront Saturday and UD's Coast Day marks its 50th year Sunday at the Hugh R. Sharp Campus. Sidewalk sales run Oct. 2–4 in Lewes and Rehoboth, the Cape Henlopen hawk watch continues through November, and October brings Apple-Scrapple in Bridgeville, True Blue Jazz in Lewes, and Sea Witch's Community Fair and costume parade on Oct. 23–24.
hiddenGemNote: Tower 7 (Cape Henlopen State Park) held: current access not yet confirmed with the park. No Hidden Gem was published this week.

dailySlots.headline: Sidewalk sales bookend the coast this weekend
dailySlots.note: Lewes merchants and the Rehoboth–Dewey resort area both run fall sidewalk sales Oct. 2–4, and Delaware Botanic Gardens in Dagsboro offers guided Welcome Walks at 10 a.m. on Oct. 2 and 3.

dailySlots.headline: Fifty years of Coast Day
dailySlots.note: Coast Day turns 50 this year. The University of Delaware opens its Lewes campus for hands-on marine science, live demonstrations, and lab and ship tours. Fifth graders can still enter the essay contest on Delaware's habitats and ecosystems through Oct. 9.

editorialNotes: W40 approved for publication 2026-10-02, four days into the week. Daily slots for Sept. 28 – Oct. 1 were dropped as past. Held: Sea Witch parade time, Return Day (Nov. 5, inferred), Tower 7 Hidden Gem. First-party-ingested events were reused rather than duplicated.
